title: Pottering Pygmy Squid
statement: A small, round bobtail squid that spends its evenings fussing over a tiny grove of bioluminescent algae, rearranging grains of sand with its arms in quiet, fussy devotion—as though the whole dim tank were a gentle puzzle it is slowly, contentedly solving. It glows faintly amber from within, and if you watch long enough, you'll notice it has organized every pebble by size.
